name: Chapadão do Lageado (Brazil)
description: Divided diagonally green over yellow by a band of blue, red and white rising from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the municipal arms.
history: Chapadão do Lageado is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 31 October 1997 (created with the arms by Municipal Law No. 42 of 31 October 1997, according to Flags of the World and Portuguese Wikipedia).

features.role: green upper hoist and yellow lower fly
band of blue, red and white
municipal arms with a crown, a landscape and a tree, reading CHAPADÃO DO LAGEADO
